definitions.gloss: a big eater; someone with a large appetite; a glutton
definitions.explanation: a person who eats large quantities of food
a competition to see who can eat the most food in a given time

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{大食|おおぐ}いだ。
examples.english: My younger brother is a big eater.

examples.japanese: {大食|おおぐ}いなので{食費|しょくひ}がかかる。
examples.english: I spend a lot on food because I'm a big eater.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}から{大食|おおぐ}いで、いつも{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}に{行|い}っていた。
examples.english: I've been a big eater since childhood and always went to all-you-can-eat places.

examples.japanese: {大食|おおぐ}い{選手権|せんしゅけん}に{出場|しゅつじょう}した。
examples.english: I participated in an eating contest.

examples.japanese: テレビで{大食|おおぐ}い{番組|ばんぐみ}を{見|み}るのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like watching competitive eating shows on TV.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{大食|おおぐ}いチャレンジで{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This restaurant is famous for its eating challenge.

notes:
FORMATION:
{大|おお} (big, large) + {食|ぐ}い (eating) → big eating

FUNCTIONS:
- As a noun: {大食|おおぐ}いの{人|ひと} (a big eater)
- As a na-adjective: {大食|おおぐ}いな{人|ひと} (a person who eats a lot)

TV ENTERTAINMENT:
{大食|おおぐ}い{番組|ばんぐみ} (competitive eating shows) are popular in Japan. Famous competitive eaters ({フードファイター}) become celebrities.

CONTRAST:
- {大食|おおぐ}い (big eater) - eats large quantities
- {少食|しょうしょく} (light eater) - eats small quantities
- {早食|はやぐ}い (fast eater) - eats quickly

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- よく{食|た}べる (to eat a lot)
- {食|く}いしん{坊|ぼう} (glutton, foodie)
- {腹|はら}ペコ (hungry, starving)
